basic_info.description: Fully detached Mid-Century home in the delightful Midtown Terrace neighborhood. Clean lines & beautiful details inside and outside. Lushly landscaped back yard. Truly an exceptional elegant spacious entertainers dream home on two levels. Open floor plan with three bedrooms on main floor plus formal living room with fireplace and dining area. Family, media or fourth bedroom on the lower level. Beautiful solid oak hardwood floors. Downstairs opens to extra wide patio. Wide picture windows. Dynamic ocean views. Laundry area. Two car parking and considerable storage areas plus development potential. Central San Francisco location. Superb neighborhood close to Haight, Castro, Noe Valley, West Portal, Irving & 9th Avenue. Easy 101+280 freeway access.
